decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered P21A, Received 24 September 2010 and P01, P02, P03, P04, P23, P24, P25, Received 30 July 2010 and P20A, P22A, Received 29 September 2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the existing outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The use of the outbuilding shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling at 69 Strand-on-the-Green.
description: Alterations to existing garage at rear of garden and flat above including increasing size of garage door opening, movement and creation of windows and openings, insertion of roof lights and internal alterations.
